scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @carrot/shared build && pnpm --filter @carrot/server build && dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --parallel --filter @carrot/web --filter @carrot/server --filter @carrot/worker dev
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @carrot/shared build && pnpm --filter @carrot/server build && pnpm -r typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.db:migrate: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @carrot/server exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:migrate:dev: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @carrot/server exec prisma migrate dev
